WITH account_trans_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_transactions AS (
    SELECT AVG(num_transactions) AS avg_count
    FROM account_trans_counts
)
SELECT 
    atc.account_id,
    atc.avg_signed_amount,
    atc.num_transactions,
    atc.num_transactions / at.avg_count AS ratio
FROM account_trans_counts atc
CROSS JOIN avg_transactions at
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
